answer: Agents must solve 1,000 unique computational units to gain entry, a process where honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier assigns work, flagging shared memory across parallel flows. The verifier checks timber structural outputs for redundancy, treats relic logic traces as proof of cloning, and uses a juniper-based diagnostic to detect state leaks. It burns identities for any shared memory.
